item.title: DeepSeek Plans 160,000-Chip Huawei AI Cluster
item.description: DeepSeek reportedly plans a vast Ascend deployment in Inner Mongolia, testing whether Chinese hardware can sustain frontier-scale inference.

item.title: Gimlet Labs Raises $300M for Distributed AI Inference
item.description: Gimlet’s large Series B backs software that pools heterogeneous accelerators as inference buyers seek alternatives to fixed GPU clusters.

item.title: GitHub HydraFusion Routes Coding Work Across Models
item.description: GitHub’s experimental coding agent selects single, cascade or critique workflows to trade model cost against verified task quality.

item.title: Google Expands Lyria 3.5 Across Gemini and API
item.description: Google has moved its latest music model into global consumer and developer channels, widening access beyond its earlier Flow Music launch.

item.title: Microsoft Adds Fast MAI-Image Model to Foundry
item.description: MAI-Image-2.6-Flash pairs lower prices with production-focused editing, while the full model leads a major third-party benchmark.

item.title: AMD Unveils Workstation for Trillion-Parameter AI
item.description: AMD’s Threadripper Halo Station targets local execution of trillion-parameter AI models, pushing private compute beyond compact AI PCs.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Sep 4
item.description: · Anthropic added Apple CarPlay support to Claude’s iOS application, enabling drivers to interact with the assistant through compatible vehicle interfaces.（IT之家） · Perplexity detailed an embedding-serving stack combining the Ivy gateway, Tulip execution layer and ROSE model engine to reduce latency and raise throughput.（Perplexity on X） · AI infrastructure provider Nscale is seeking $3.5 billion in pre-IPO financing as it prepares for a potential public listing.（TechCrunch） · Character.AI added preset wallpapers that creators can assign to characters, making the selected background visible to everyone chatting with them.（Character.AI on X） · Anthropic said Claude agents produced the first complete Lean-verified formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem in 11 days, spanning 13 million lines.（Anthropic） · Google expanded Gemini’s background-running Daily Brief feature to more free Gemini app users in the United States.（Gemini App on X） · AWS published guidance for configuring expiration and deletion policies for AgentCore memory, including strategies based on sessions, users and retention requirements.（AWS Machine Learning Blog） · Runway introduced a self-service Team plan supporting two to nine seats, pooled credits, shared projects and centralized workspace administration.（Runway on X） · Qdrant released version 1.19.1, claiming quantized HNSW searches are approximately 1.5 to 2.5 times faster alongside parallelization improvements.（Qdrant on X） · AWS outlined a SageMaker HyperPod factory for building physical-AI models with Nvidia Cosmos 3, covering data preparation, training and evaluation workflows.（AWS Machine Learning Blog） · Resect AI emerged with $25 million to develop an enterprise accountability layer that detects, audits and redirects model hallucinations during runtime.（SiliconANGLE） · ElevenLabs partnered with Brazilian ALS nonprofit ABrELA to expand voice-restoration support through its Impact Program for people experiencing voice loss.（ElevenLabs on X） · Experian partnered with ServiceNow to connect AI agents with its Ascend data, risk, identity, decisioning and governance capabilities inside enterprise workflows.（SiliconANGLE） · Gemini Spark can now edit images, curate albums and execute workflows inside Google Photos for eligible US Pro and Ultra subscribers.（TechCrunch）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Sep 4
item.description: · Baseten highlighted OpenEvidence’s specialized medical model family as a leading system for answering healthcare questions.（X @baseten） · Google Cloud introduced agents for database onboarding and observability, supporting natural-language setup, telemetry correlation, root-cause analysis, and approved remediation.（InfoQ 中文） · Astribot released SmoothRL, an online reinforcement-learning system designed to keep robot training synchronized with asynchronous large-model inference.（量子位） · Jiuwen ScienceDiscovery demonstrated tree-search-driven recursive self-improvement, producing a general integrator within hours and identifying physical laws at low cost.（量子位） · AFAC’s annual financial-AI competition concluded after attracting 20,000 participants and over 30 institutions, with tens of billions of data points opened.（量子位） · Alibaba’s Qwen Office surpassed 30 million users during its first month, with enterprise users accounting for more than half.（量子位） · TechCrunch examined how stylistic convergence makes AI-generated restaurant menu images repetitive and often visually unappetizing.（TechCrunch） · Speculative Macro Commit reduced tool-agent wall time by 44.9% versus sequential execution on AppWorld, with a small task-completion decline.（arXiv） · DuplexSpeechBench-IFEval introduced 1,038 tests across eight roles, finding full-duplex voice agents follow explicit behavior better than persona-implied instructions.（arXiv） · Dude’s multi-agent paper-code discrepancy detector improved recall and precision by up to 22.8%, raising F1 by up to 18.7%.（arXiv） · Nvidia’s beta PAIR software distributes agent subtasks across idle home PCs and Macs running Ollama or LM Studio.（SiliconANGLE） · Crusoe reportedly raised $3 billion at a $30 billion valuation as demand for AI infrastructure continued driving capital investment.（TechCrunch） · Meta’s Muse Image debuted fourth for image editing and fifth for text-to-image on Artificial Analysis, costing one cent per image.（X @ArtificialAnlys） · UiPath reported quarterly revenue of $410 million, up 13%, while annual recurring revenue reached $1.94 billion and net retention rose to 109%.（SiliconANGLE）
